authority: NNV topology is the authority; PMU supplies structures only, never layout or environment
conclusion: No NNV house can currently be replaced by a PMU structure at native resolution. The blocker is a proved scale mismatch between NNV's high-resolution house sprites and PMU's 32 px tile art, not a missing asset. This stays fail-closed rather than resampling either side.

targets.blocking_reason: no AUTONOMOUS_CONFIRMED PMU structure reaches the native footprint 1192x728px; largest confirmed candidate is tiles9_0554 at 196x230px (x6.1 narrower, x3.2 shorter). Upscaling PMU art to fill the NNV footprint would invent pixels and is forbidden; shrinking the NNV plot to fit would let PMU dictate NNV topology and is forbidden.
targets.structural_perimeter: sprite pixels only; surrounding terrain, trees, roads, rocks and empty space are NNV data and are never part of this structure
